Sieve of Eratosthenes Visualizer

Watch the classic sieve cross out composites step by step on an animated grid, with primes highlighted.

Press Run to animate the sieve.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter N (10–400).
  2. Press Run to animate, or Step to advance manually.
  3. Green cells are the primes found up to N.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the sieve work?

Take the smallest uncrossed number p, mark it prime, and cross out its multiples starting at p² — repeat until p² > N.

Why start crossing at p²?

Smaller multiples of p were already crossed out by smaller primes, so p² is the first new one.

What remains at the end?

Every uncrossed number from 2 to N — exactly the primes, listed below the grid.
